about: Fifty questions a person might ask an AI assistant about U.S. economic data on FRED. Each has a machine-readable spec from which build_key.py computes the correct answer from FRED and ALFRED at run time. Questions are written in plain language, without series IDs, because that is how people ask.

categories.L: Latest value: tests whether the answer is current and names its period
categories.H: Historical value: a fixed fact that should never be wrong
categories.C: Computed: needs several observations and a calculation
categories.V: Vintage: what was first reported, or known on a date, versus now; the official connector has no vintages
categories.A: Attribution: the original source, units or frequency behind a FRED series
